description: Frozen nonlinear scoring setup (ace/nonlinear.py): base_bottom f33 held in x, y, z; prong tops f17 and f34 moved by a sticking platen, displacement [0, -u_part, 0], ramped to u_part_max_mm in equal increments with NLGEOM (retried with adaptive increments if a run does not converge); J2 isotropic hardening from material_file. Force F = -(Ry on f17 + Ry on f34). Crosshead travel u_cross = u_part + delta_mm + compliance_mm_per_N * F, with (0, 0) prepended. Error = mean over checkpoints_mm of |F_sim - F_meas| / F_meas, F_meas from the test's loading branch up to its peak.

calibration.note: delta_mm and compliance_mm_per_N fitted once on the finest mesh against the measured curve, then frozen for every mesh.

auto.label: automesher
auto.note: curved P2 (gmsh default sizes), only the midside nodes CalculiX rejects straightened; the earlier 16.6 % straightened every midside node, which facets the curved faces
